title: The List
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy becomes the new manager and appoints Dwight as his enforcer, leading to Dwight intensifying his physical training and confrontations. Meanwhile, Jim and Pam discover a mysterious list in Robert California's notebook that divides the office staff into two columns, sparking curiosity and conflict among employees. Robert dismisses the list as a doodle, but Dwight uses it to provoke a mock fight between the groups. The staff shares a lunch reflecting on the list's impact, while Andy tries to challenge Robert's categorization of employees as winners or losers without success. The episode also features various office interactions and culminates with Dwight insisting on treating Robert to a meal, demanding tips from coworkers, and Gabe revealing feelings of childhood exclusion.
